name: wds_stl10
description: wds_stl10 is a WebDataset-packaged version of the STL-10 image classification benchmark. It measures image classification performance on 10 object categories and is commonly used to evaluate supervised and unsupervised/representation learning approaches with limited labeled data. The dataset is useful for prototyping and comparing image recognition models under a small-label/large-unlabel regime.
reputation: Widely used small-scale benchmark for image classification and representation learning, popular for rapid prototyping and method comparison.
